description: This source file defines a class 'ClassSingleSegmentBuffer' that implements the IBufferWriter<byte> interface, providing a buffer management utility with methods for writing, resetting, and accessing buffer data.

classes.name: ClassSingleSegmentBuffer
classes.description: A class that provides single-segment buffer management implementing IBufferWriter<byte>, allowing writing to an internal byte array, advancing write position, retrieving data as memory, span, array, or read-only sequence, and resetting the buffer.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the write position by the specified number of bytes.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> representing the buffer starting at the current write position.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> representing the buffer starting at the current write position.

methods.name: ToArray
methods.description: Converts the written portion of the buffer into a byte array.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the write position to zero, clearing the buffer.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written to the buffer.

methods.name: GetReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySequence<byte> over the written data.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the written buffer data decoded in UTF8.
